thread:
Riley: Kickoff sync — want to align stakeholders & 90-day success criteria for NovaHealth onboarding. @Marta can you confirm primary contact and internal owners? Proposed timeline: M1 data ingest, M2 validation & QA, M3 go-live. Main risks: data mapping and SSO security review. Thoughts?
Marta: Thanks Riley — confirmed. I'm the PM (Marta Delgado). Internal owners: Alex (IT), Sun (Data Eng), Lila (Clinical). SSO needs security review (likely 2–3 weeks).
Riley: Got it. @Jared can you scope integration effort once you have schema? Also we'll need a sample schema by Friday.
Jared: Happy to scope. Quick Q — expected payload size per record? If large we'll recommend batching. I'll loop in Evan for infra implications.
Evan: Agreed. If payloads are large we should use S3 signed uploads + async ingest to avoid timeouts. Infra config ETA: ~5 business days after schema is final.
Priya: I'll own enablement scheduling: product walkthrough week of 2026-03-29, API deep-dive 2026-04-05. Proposed success metrics: 95% requests <300ms median latency, error rate <1%, and 30-day adoption target = 200 DAU.
Riley: Noted. Renewal risk flags: performance regressions or slow adoption -> high risk. We'll add baseline automated evals post-go-live and weekly quality checks. @OnboardBot please create task: baseline eval set + weekly checks.
OnboardBot: Task created: "baseline eval set" assigned to Riley. Due 2026-04-12.
Marta: :thumbsup: For feedback capture, we'll run weekly NPS + feature feedback via cs-feedback@novah.com, cc Priya.
Jared: For schema, sending draft by EOD Thu. sample payload preview:
```json
{"patient_id":"abc123","encounter_text":"...","timestamp":"2026-03-20T14:22:00Z"}
```
Riley: Great. Owners roundup: Riley (CSM), Marta (Customer PM), Jared (SE), Evan (Infra), Priya (Enablement). Next check-in: Tue 2026-03-30 10:00am PT. Any blockers?
Marta: SSO security review scheduled 2026-03-28. If it flags issues we may need to slide M1 by ~2 weeks.
Priya: I'll prepare the enablement checklist and drop it in #cs-ops before the walkthrough.
Jared: Note from SE side — recommend tokenization/preprocessing on ingest to reduce payload size and latency. I'll add a short note to the integration doc.
Riley: Thanks everyone — I'll update the kickoff playbook and share the doc link in this thread after this sync. :party-parrot:
